decision: The broad common NRA approval mechanism is falsified as a substitute for required substantive inventory/lifecycle work. One plain approval is already an X1 clone. More limited agreement templates already exist and still require distinct instruments, geography, conditions and lifecycle histories. No new measured marginal agent saving or >=100 net-hour / >=5x investment claim follows.

All 12 representations retain existing derivative/printed-copy grades and pending source/page confirmation; no original authentication conferred.
